notes.title: Huge Update: Zombies, Action Roguelite, & More!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone!
We’ve just dropped our biggest update yet for [b]Rebloom[/b], and it changes everything:[/p][h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Genre Twist[/b] - Rebloom now plays as an [b]action roguelite[/b]! Fast-paced survival and progression.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiple Islands[/b] - Smaller areas with a time limit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zombies & Bosses[/b] - Face off against hordes of infected zombies and bosses guarding each island.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infection Levels[/b] - Increase the difficulty for no extra reward.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Jump In & Tell Us What You Think[/h3][p]This update is still in demo form - your feedback will directly shape how these new systems evolve before full release.[/p][p][b]Play the updated demo now:[/b] [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3823300/Rebloom/"]Rebloom on Steam[/url]
[b]Share your feedback here:[/b] [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3823300/discussions/0/"]Community Hub[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing :)[/p]
